requirements.Title: AI Productivity and Manageability Solutions
requirements.Description: Integrate advanced AI-based productivity and manageability solutions, including Perfect Print and Perfect Scan, to streamline workflows and device management for SMBs.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs need efficient, easy-to-manage solutions without dedicated IT teams. AI features differentiate Magellan from competitors and address key customer needs for ROI and efficiency.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires AI software integration, compatible hardware, and SMB portal development.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: AI-based Perfect Print and Perfect Scan functionalities are available and improve workflow efficiency by at least 20% over standard solutions. Usability validated with non-IT users in SMBs.

requirements.Title: Lowest Business Total Cost of Ownership (TCO)
requirements.Description: Design Magellan as HP’s most cost-efficient color printing solution for SMBs, ensuring lowest TCO through high-yield tanks, minimal intervention, and reduced maintenance.
requirements.Rationale: Cost efficiency is a top priority for SMBs. Lowest TCO is a key differentiator and core value proposition for Magellan.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires high-yield ink tank system, optimized consumables, and robust hardware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: TCO for Magellan is demonstrably lower than comparable SMB printers (by at least 10%) in independent testing.

requirements.Title: Serviceability – Customer Replaceable Parts
requirements.Description: Enable customer replaceable parts (e.g., maintenance box) and ensure ease of service with PHA (customer replaceable) and MINK (service center, if out of warranty) thresholds.
requirements.Rationale: SMBs lack dedicated IT support and require simple, low-cost servicing options to minimize downtime.
requirements.Dependencies: Design for serviceability, documentation, and part supply chain.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: 80%+ of common service events can be handled by customers without professional intervention. User documentation provided.

requirements.Title: Keyed Ink Bottles
requirements.Description: Implement keyed ink bottles to prevent incorrect refilling and ensure compatibility with Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Reduces user error and service calls, improving user experience and reducing support costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Requires unique bottle design and printer detection mechanism.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Keyed bottles are physically incompatible with incorrect tanks; 100% prevention rate in usability tests.

requirements.Title: Non-PDL SKU – SMB Portal and PaaS Support
requirements.Description: For Non-PDL SKUs, integrate SMB2.0 Solutions and Advanced View SMB portal, and ensure support for Printing-as-a-Service (PaaS) models.
requirements.Rationale: SMB customers require centralized, simple management and flexible service models.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal development, PaaS infrastructure, and integration with printer firmware.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Non-PDL SKUs support SMB portal and PaaS; validated in controlled SMB pilot.

requirements.Title: PDL SKU – Enhanced Speed and PDL/PS Support
requirements.Description: For PDL SKUs, provide improved print speed (25/20 ppm target) and support for PDL/PS (Page Description Language/PostScript).
requirements.Rationale: Higher speed and PDL/PS support are critical for advanced SMB workflows and compatibility.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware and firmware capable of target speeds and PDL/PS support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: PDL SKUs achieve 25/20 ppm and pass compatibility tests with PDL/PS applications.

requirements.Title: Blue Angel Certification
requirements.Description: Ensure Magellan meets Blue Angel environmental certification requirements for relevant SKUs.
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and increasingly required in many markets.
requirements.Dependencies: Design, materials, and manufacturing processes must comply with Blue Angel standards.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Blue Angel certification is obtained for designated SKUs before launch.

requirements.Title: Replaceable Maintenance Box
requirements.Description: Introduce a replaceable maintenance box as a new feature for Magellan, enabling users to easily maintain printer health.
requirements.Rationale: Addresses new use-cases and pain points for SMBs, reducing downtime and service costs.
requirements.Dependencies: Design for user replacement, supply chain for maintenance boxes.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Maintenance box can be replaced by users in under 5 minutes with provided instructions; success rate >95% in testing.

requirements.Title: Consolidated Device Management Portal (SMB Portal)
requirements.Description: Develop a consolidated portal for device management, targeting unmanaged and lightly managed SMBs for easy printer monitoring, configuration, and support.
requirements.Rationale: Office managers/generalist IT need simple, centralized management tools to handle multiple printers efficiently.
requirements.Dependencies: Portal software development, printer integration, security compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Portal allows management of at least 15 printers, with positive usability feedback from SMB pilot users.

requirements.Title: Mobile Printing and HP App Integration
requirements.Description: Enable seamless mobile printing and integration with the HP App for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Mobile printing is a core SMB use case and a top customer priority.
requirements.Dependencies: HP App compatibility and printer firmware support.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Users can print from mobile devices via HP App with >98% success rate in user testing.

requirements.Title: High Recycled Content Plastic (RCP)
requirements.Description: Use at least 60% recycled content plastic (RCP) in Magellan’s construction to exceed competitor benchmarks (Epson 30%, Canon TBC).
requirements.Rationale: Sustainability is a key differentiator and aligns with HP’s environmental goals.
requirements.Dependencies: Supply chain sourcing, manufacturing process adaptation.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Material composition verified by third-party audit; 60%+ RCP in all applicable parts.

requirements.Title: Warranty – 80,000 Pages or 2 Years
requirements.Description: Offer a warranty covering 80,000 pages or 2 years (whichever comes first) for Magellan printers.
requirements.Rationale: Provides assurance to SMBs about durability and reliability, supporting purchase decision.
requirements.Dependencies: Hardware reliability and warranty support infrastructure.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Warranty terms are clearly documented and implemented in all regions at launch.

requirements.Title: Telemetry and Advanced Analytics
requirements.Description: Implement robust telemetry features to collect device usage, health, and performance data for proactive support and insights.
requirements.Rationale: Enables advanced support, predictive maintenance, and continuous improvement for SMB customers.
requirements.Dependencies: Telemetry module integration, data privacy compliance.
requirements.Acceptance Criteria: Telemetry data is collected, anonymized, and accessible in the SMB portal; compliance with privacy regulations demonstrated.
